overview_description.description:
TrueNorth aims to fix inefficiencies in the independent, yet fragmented, trucking industry.

TrueNorth, established by Stedge and Sanjaya Wijeratne, develops software that puts “independent truckers under one roof.” While TrueNorth doesn’t lease trucks, it helps truckers have a platform to manage insurance, fuel, and maintenance.

TrueNorth also helps truckers with route optimization, dispatch and load coordination, and automated tracking.

product.name: TrueNorth App
product.description: A mobile application that enables truckers to search, book, and manage freight loads, send invoices, and track financial performance.

product.name: Loadboard with Broker Network
product.description: A digital load marketplace providing access to over 100,000 daily freight loads from more than 6,000 vetted brokers.

product.name: Document Management and Invoicing
product.description: A system to manage load documents and send invoices and load-related paperwork directly to brokers or factoring companies.

product.name: Financial Insights and Profit Tracking
product.description: Tools that provide personalized financial data to help carriers evaluate load profitability and monitor business performance.

identifier.value: New Authority Program and Educational Resources

product.name: New Authority Program and Educational Resources
product.description: A program offering tutorials, training videos, and resources tailored to new trucking carriers starting their motor carrier authority.

product.name: Broker Setup Assistance
product.description: Support and information to help carriers complete the onboarding and compliance process required by freight brokers.
